messages:
Priya: Heads-up — customer acme-inc hitting 403 on embeddings after SSO rotation. Generation endpoint still returns 200. Key: svckey_ABC123. Repro steps below, can someone triage?

Jordan: Which endpoint + error body? request_id?

Priya: Repro curl: ```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer svckey_ABC123" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{"input":["foo"]}'```
Response: ```{"error":{"code":403,"message":"insufficient scope: embeddings","request_id":"req_20260301_9f3b"}}```

Michael: :thinking: quick guess — looks like token claim doesn't include the literal comma-delimited scope we expect. Our provisioner historically supports commas, but some SAML attribute sources use spaces. Can you inspect the raw token payload?

Priya: Ran this on the token: ```echo "<JWT>" | cut -d'.' -f2 | base64 -d | jq .```
Payload shows: ```{
  "sub": "svcacct:acme:123",
  "scopes": "inference embeddings rerank",
  "exp": 1710000000
}```
So scopes are a single space-separated string, not a CSV.

Jordan: That explains it — our auth validator splits on `,` only, so it treats the whole string as one scope and doesn't match `embeddings`.

Michael: Short-term fixes: (1) Re-provisioning the key from Admin UI will normalize scopes into comma-separated list — ask customer to try that. (2) Medium-term: I'll push a small auth-service patch to accept whitespace-delimited scopes (split on `[ ,]+`) and backfill existing keys where the scope claim contains spaces.

Jordan: I'll create a hotfix branch and roll to canary in ~2h, full prod in 24h if no regressions. Will also add a migration job to convert stored scope strings to CSV.

SE-CaseBot: Ticket updated: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/REM-12345 (customer contacted, workaround: re-provision key)

Priya: :thumbsup: I'll send the workaround to the customer (re-provision from Admin -> Service keys) and ask them to retry. If they want us to re-provision we can do it for them.

Jordan: Good — I'll post here when canary is up. Michael — please include a small unit test for mixed delimiters.

Michael: Will do. Also adding logging for unexpected scope formats so we catch similar tenants earlier.

Priya: Thanks team. Marking as escalation-assigned to SE and eng-auth.
